# Analytics Report Template

**Format:** Markdown Report
**Frequency:** Monthly
**Purpose:** Comprehensive performance tracking across content, SEO, engagement, and business metrics
**Generated By:** Performance-Tracking Workflow / Insight Performance Metrics Analyst Agent

---

```markdown
# Content Performance Report – {Month} {Year}
```

## Template Variables

```yaml
{ month }: Report month
{ year }: Report year
{ start_date }: Reporting period start
{ end_date }: Reporting period end
{ report_date }: Generation date
{ total_sessions }: GA4 sessions
{ total_users }: GA4 users
{ pageviews }: Total pageviews
{ organic_traffic }: Organic search sessions
{ avg_time }: Average time on page
{ bounce_rate }: Bounce rate percentage
{ count }: Various counts throughout
{ change }: Percentage change MoM
{ target }: Target metric value
{ status }: Status emoji/indicator
{ traffic }: Traffic amount
{ keyword }: Target/ranking keyword
{ position }: Search position
{ title }: Article/content title
{ url }: Content URL
```

---

## Usage Notes

- Generate automatically on 1st of each month
- Compare against previous month and targets
- Include visualizations where helpful (charts, graphs)
- Make actionable with clear next steps
- Archive for historical trending
- Share with stakeholders as needed
- Use as input for next month's content plan
